description: Defines a helper class 'dl_ssb_pdu_builder' for constructing and setting parameters of 'dl_ssb_pdu' objects related to 5G NR SSB PDU configuration, including carrier, cell, power, SSB, and BCH payload parameters.

classes.name: dl_ssb_pdu_builder
classes.description: Helper class to facilitate setting parameters for 'dl_ssb_pdu' objects related to 5G NR SSB PDU configuration.

methods.name: set_carrier_parameters
methods.description: Sets the carrier parameters (subcarrier spacing) for the SSB/PBCH PDU.

methods.name: set_cell_parameters
methods.description: Sets the cell parameters (physical cell ID) for the SSB/PBCH PDU.

methods.name: set_power_parameters
methods.description: Sets the power parameters (beta PSS profile) for the SSB/PBCH PDU.

methods.name: set_ssb_parameters
methods.description: Sets specific SSB parameters including block index, subcarrier offset, point A offset, pattern case, and L_max.

methods.name: set_bch_payload_phy_timing_info
methods.description: Sets the BCH payload with PHY timing info, ensuring payload is within bounds.
